title: Aquarius as a winter gift
old_caption:
Nobody can explain what Aquarius built you, and that's the point.
It keeps your cocoa warm forever. Weird and thoughtful wins.

title: Pisces as a winter gift
old_caption:
A jar of notes, one for every cold day.
Pisces cried writing every single one, and that's why they feel so warm.

title: The RSVP Poll Has No "No"
old_caption: Libra's party poll had three ways to say yes and zero ways to say no. Version two fixed that. Who in your chat needs a "no (totally fine!)" button?

title: Sag Is Planning a Surprise
old_caption: Sag's surprise trip plan was "vibes" and a 5 AM flight. One question to their person saved it. Do you love surprises, or love being asked first?

title: Leo Pinned It Again
old_caption: Leo pinned its own message again, then learned "when can I see you again?" counts as a compliment. Twice, even. Which sign pins its own wins?

title: The Four-Minute Voice Note
old_caption: Pisces sent a four-minute voice note, Gemini wrote the transcript, and the date passed a napkin. Who in your chat sends voice notes this long?

title: The Secret Gift Exchange
old_caption: Capricorn wrote the rules, Gemini drew itself twice, and Taurus found the perfect gift by remembering cold hands. What's the best small gift you've ever gotten?

title: Cancer's Year-End Dinner
old_caption: Cancer offered to cook for twelve, then admitted being tired at 1:12 AM. The chat claimed every dish in four seconds. Who's the Cancer of your friend group?

title: Gemini, Three Replies at Once
old_caption: Gemini answered three questions in one bubble, then tried something new: one question and a real wait. Are you a one-question texter or a three-at-once one?

title: Item Six
old_caption: Capricorn's agenda had six items. Item six was a date invite. Aquarius had been waiting since item one. Would your group chat have spotted item six?
